label: diffuse: weak k/m-history and early-copy (DEL, first outputs) bias
explanation: Sparse (about 1% of steps) and spread over every phase: never active at t=0-1 and rarely after original position 4. The weak structure it has: enriched at the delimiter and the first two copy outputs (recall_idx 0-1, about 46% of mass, but only about 2.7% precision), and when k or m was the input one or two steps back (about 5x lift). The largest activations are at <DEL> and the first copy output in sequences containing k/m (e.g. "k m m <DEL>"), but this is not consistent. No predicate tried got F1 above about 0.14; the best was k/m two steps back followed by k/m/a/v/<DEL>. No reliable magnitude modulator was found.
